title: Update on the interviews and documentary.
content: I’ve had some serious problems with my car so it’s going to be a bit longer than I had hoped before I can get on the road, however that also means there’s still time if you would like to be involved either by doing an interview or helping out with the project in some other way, just send me a message if you’re interested and/or have some experience with any part of the process and would like to help.
